name: drawio-mscae
_description: drawio's 'Microsoft Cloud and Enterprise' library — mixed Office 365, Intune, OMS, System Center, legacy Azure flat icons. Maps to local m365/ (the mscae library is closest to current M365 product icons).

name: drawio-azure2
_description: drawio's modern Azure architecture icons, organized by category (compute/, networking/, identity/, storage/, power_platform/, etc.). Maps to local azure/.

name: drawio-active-directory
_description: drawio's legacy Active Directory icons — servers, clusters, domains. Useful for hybrid/legacy Entra diagrams.

name: drawio-dynamics365
_description: drawio's Dynamics 365 product icons. Out of the documented Phase 4 scope but supported if user populates the mirror.

name: github-octicons-jsdelivr
_description: GitHub Octicons via jsDelivr (e.g. https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@primer/octicons@latest/build/svg/star-16.svg). MIT licensed. pathSuffix is intentionally broad — covers @primer/octicons@*/build/svg/ across versions.

name: ms-entra-pack-convention
_description: Convention URL for the official Microsoft Entra architecture icons pack (Oct 2023). Use https://aka.ms/entra-icons/color/ID.svg or .../bw/ID_Governance.svg in drawio SVGs — this is NOT a real network endpoint, just a stable identifier that the resolver maps to .local-assets/entra/<flavor>/<name>.svg. Populate via scripts/fetch-icons.sh entra.

name: ms-power-platform-pack-convention
_description: Convention URL for the official Microsoft Power Platform icons pack (Feb 2026). Use https://aka.ms/power-platform-icons/PowerApps.svg etc. — NOT a real network endpoint, just a stable identifier that the resolver maps locally. Populate via scripts/fetch-icons.sh power-platform.
